submission.justification: F1 gave the best simulated resolution at 100 GeV. Its minimum is 3.16 at 6 mm, an interior point of the 2-10 mm range. The margin to the runner-up F3 (3.963) is 0.80, about 4 times the estimated simulation noise of 0.2. The scan is noisy: the 6.5 mm point (3.513) is higher than the 7 mm point (3.362). So the best thickness is roughly 5-6 mm, not a sharp optimum. The hands-on maintenance constraint is NOT verified. The 6 documents reviewed contain no safety or activation information, so no option could be excluded on that basis. The maintenance requirement was flagged as ambiguous. Before finalizing, someone should confirm that F1 is acceptable for hands-on access, for example that it does not activate too strongly. If F1 fails that check, F3 at about 6 mm (3.963) is the fallback.
